#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PRE-P5 emergency SSH recovery controller v5.
# Run from Google Cloud Shell as a child process:
#   bash ~/ssh-emergency-repair-controller.sh
#
# Safety boundaries:
# - zonal MIG only; no template update and no MIG rollout
# - same instance reset only; no recreate/replace
# - no disk attach/detach/delete/format
# - /data is read-only to this repair
# - restore only the previously persisted SSH host keys
# - never generate host keys
# - restore the exact original startup-script bytes after guest pickup

set -Eeuo pipefail

PROJECT='project-55dd5a94-2034-4bf7-a7e'
ZONE='asia-southeast1-b'
MIG='k3-p4-mig'
INSTANCE='k3-p4-mig-xnmd'

EXPECTED_INSTANCE_ID='36457609588001649'
EXPECTED_DATA_UUID='bb010006-7309-419d-bf55-0c7fbd763b76'
EXPECTED_DATA_DISK='https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/project-55dd5a94-2034-4bf7-a7e/zones/asia-southeast1-b/disks/k3-p4-mig-xnmd-1'
EXPECTED_EXTERNAL_IP='136.85.49.91'
EXPECTED_ED25519_FP='SHA256:QeBEEeQqwZgCqWF+wBdxjULa0AtzHaiXJ9HTdicWrDs'
EXPECTED_ORIGINAL_STARTUP_SHA256='551232df0ffe4067f0e483616b551292b8a19100fbf1e0ff59109bbdfadc9e77'

RUN_ID="ssh-emergency-$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
EVIDENCE_DIR="$HOME/pre-p5-recovery/$RUN_ID"
ORIGINAL_STARTUP="$EVIDENCE_DIR/original-startup-script.sh"
REPAIR_STARTUP="$EVIDENCE_DIR/ssh-emergency-repair.sh"
SERIAL_LATEST="$EVIDENCE_DIR/serial-latest.txt"
METADATA_SWAPPED=0
METADATA_RESTORED=0

mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE_DIR"
printf '%s\n' "$RUN_ID" >"$EVIDENCE_DIR/run-id.txt"

extract_startup_exact() {
  local input_json=$1 output_file=$2
  python3 - "$input_json" "$output_file" <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib
import sys

source = json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
values = [
    item.get("value", "")
    for item in source.get("metadata", {}).get("items", [])
    if item.get("key") == "startup-script"
]
if len(values) != 1 or not values[0]:
    raise SystemExit("expected exactly one non-empty startup-script metadata item")
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_bytes(values[0].encode("utf-8"))
PY
}

restore_original_metadata() {
  if [[ "$METADATA_SWAPPED" -eq 1 && "$METADATA_RESTORED" -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo '=== RESTORE EXACT ORIGINAL STARTUP METADATA ==='
    if gcloud compute instances add-metadata "$INSTANCE" \
      --project="$PROJECT" \
      --zone="$ZONE" \
      --metadata-from-file="startup-script=$ORIGINAL_STARTUP"; then
      METADATA_RESTORED=1
      echo 'ORIGINAL_STARTUP_METADATA_RESTORE_REQUEST=PASS'
    else
      echo 'ORIGINAL_STARTUP_METADATA_RESTORE_REQUEST=FAIL' >&2
      return 1
    fi
  fi
}

on_exit() {
  local rc=$?
  trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
  if [[ "$METADATA_SWAPPED" -eq 1 && "$METADATA_RESTORED" -eq 0 ]]; then
    if ! restore_original_metadata; then
      echo 'ORIGINAL_STARTUP_METADATA_RESTORE_ON_EXIT=FAIL' >&2
      [[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]] || rc=92
    fi
  fi
  exit "$rc"
}
trap on_exit EXIT HUP INT TERM

echo '=== PRECHANGE ZONAL MIG GATE ==='
gcloud compute instance-groups managed describe "$MIG" \
  --project="$PROJECT" \
  --zone="$ZONE" \
  --format=json >"$EVIDENCE_DIR/mig-before.json"

gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-instances "$MIG" \
  --project="$PROJECT" \
  --zone="$ZONE" \
  --format=json >"$EVIDENCE_DIR/mig-instances-before.json"

gcloud compute instances describe "$INSTANCE" \
  --project="$PROJECT" \
  --zone="$ZONE" \
  --format=json >"$EVIDENCE_DIR/instance-before.json"

jq -e '
  .status.isStable == true
' "$EVIDENCE_DIR/mig-before.json" >/dev/null || {
  echo 'GATE_ABORT=MIG_NOT_STABLE'
  jq '{selfLink,status,currentActions,versions}' "$EVIDENCE_DIR/mig-before.json"
  exit 20
}

jq -e --arg instance "$INSTANCE" '
  length == 1 and
  (.[0].instance | endswith("/" + $instance)) and
  .[0].instanceStatus == "RUNNING" and
  .[0].currentAction == "NONE"
' "$EVIDENCE_DIR/mig-instances-before.json" >/dev/null || {
  echo 'GATE_ABORT=MIG_INSTANCE_ACTION_NOT_NONE'
  jq '.' "$EVIDENCE_DIR/mig-instances-before.json"
  exit 21
